Name: Instant Growth Powder
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod allows you to craft Instant Growth Powder, a magic substance that is imbued with prismatic, void, and solar essences, causing anything it is sprinkled on to instantly mature.

[youtube]5iP75NZRD-4[/youtube]

To craft the powder, you will need:

1 Prismatic Shard
10 Solar Essence
10 Void Essence

To use, just select it in your toolbar and click on something that needs growing (crops, trees, fruit trees, tea bushes, farm animals, or children).

Not yet tested on children. Please don't sprinkle growth powder on your children in real life.


[size=4][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JSON Assets[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
